data.review_body:
I seemed to be one of the few people who wasn’t using Temu despite its relentless advertising. Eventually, I signed up in April, thinking I’d give it a fair chance. Unfortunately, purchasing fashion garments from Temu has been one of the most disappointing online shopping experiences I’ve had.

I gave Temu multiple opportunities to prove me wrong, but my experience has been consistently frustrating. The clothing I received looked nothing like the photos or descriptions. Items advertised as linen arrived in thin, cheap fabrics with poor stitching, inferior craftsmanship, and an overall quality that fell far below what was advertised. This wasn’t an isolated incident—it happened repeatedly across several orders.

What made the experience even worse was Temu’s response. After I complained about one of the misleading products, I was offered a $3 no-return refund. Rather than resolving the issue, it felt dismissive and disrespectful. A responsible marketplace should hold sellers accountable for deceptive listings instead of allowing misleading advertisements to continue while customers absorb the disappointment.

I’m now waiting for my final order to arrive, after which I’ll be deleting my Temu account permanently. Consumers deserve honesty, accurate product descriptions, and products that reasonably match the images used to market them. In my experience, Temu has failed to provide that standard.

I hope Temu begins enforcing stricter quality control and takes stronger action against sellers who misrepresent their products. Until then, I cannot recommend the platform for purchasing clothing.
data.review_headline: Horrible fashion garment not matching advertisements
